title: Act: Emit characterClick from the BootScene character pointerdown handler
summary: Emit characterClick with the spec id before the animation guards in createCharacter.
description: In createCharacter, the POINTER_DOWN listener first emits characterClick { id: spec.id } on phaserToReact, then runs the existing interact animation logic.
acceptance_criteria: Given a click on a character sprite, When the handler runs, Then characterClick { id: spec.id } is emitted.
Given the interact animation exists, When clicked, Then it still plays and returns to idle.
technical_constraints: Depends on characterClick type from the events file
definition_of_done: Emit placed before the early-return guards

steps.action: Inside the POINTER_DOWN callback, add phaserToReact.emit('characterClick', { id: spec.id }) as the first statement, before the 'if (!idleKey) return' guard.
steps.expected: Every character click emits characterClick; interact animation behavior is unchanged.
